issues.title: Establish declarations, image, capture, and managed documents
Implement layout-aware store, kernel, and recovery
Implement typed mutation, audit, and claim synchronization
Migrate all consumers and delete predecessors
Validate drift diagnosis and transactional repair
Document public contracts and complete release evidence

escalations.resolution: Invoker authorized one targeted guided retry and reset the rework counter.
escalations.situation: After two rework cycles, code-review run acd90fcb-ef67-4070-97cc-8bd9bb13f9cd found compare_materializations masks UndiscoveredRepositoryPath as drift.
escalations.recommendation: Authorize one targeted retry with explicit guidance to propagate every RepositoryImage::entry error and sweep all pure image consumers for the same matches!/ok-to-drift pattern.

escalations.situation: After the two invoker-authorized guided attempts, independent lead review found that the new public validation::rule_loader owns ambient filesystem reads and exposes a mixed caller-bytes/live-schema API, contrary to approved plan section 2 and D14.
escalations.resolution: Invoker chose lead take-over. Lead moved load_ruleset to storage::ruleset_store, deleted validation::rule_loader and the mixed helper, routed callers, fixed prose, added boundary tests (commit 6f4f11ac). cargo-ci passed; code-review then surfaced two more foundational deviations, triggering the batch audit below.
escalations.recommendation: Authorize one narrow correction that moves the non-mutation loader to storage, deletes the mixed-snapshot helper, routes captured paths through pure parsing only, fixes stale prose, and adds boundary coverage.

escalations.situation: Fifth review round: the whole-diff code-review kept surfacing new plan deviations in the ~6300-line foundation each round (non-convergence).
escalations.resolution: Invoker chose a batch plan-conformance audit. Lead fanned out 8 disjoint-footprint auditors over declarations + repository_state vs plan section 2, with an adversarial verify stage. 5 deviations confirmed (empty-string root sentinel -> RootRelativePath Root/Descendant enum; CaptureSpec phase-one Data-only; ExpectedPreimage kind vocabulary mirroring RepositoryEntry; managed-document claimed-child removal rejection; ConfigurationDeclarations transitional whole-config field removed), all fixed with tests (commit ff542ec1). Both gates then passed and the whole-diff code-review found nothing new, breaking the non-convergence. cbc3a7e5 done; merged to main at 0d224f35 (invoker-directed).

escalations.situation: Rework attempt 2 closed all 10 prior findings (independently verified, no regressions) but the independent crash-consistency review found 4 new lead-verified defects: HIGH shared worktree .jit-bootstrap namespace unserialized across disjoint-data-root sessions (orphan companion sweep can delete a live transaction's rollback backup); MEDIUM committed-journal recovery re-asserts worktree final identities and wedges opens after legitimate post-commit edits; LOW memory-backend failure-point parity gap; LOW tautological held-FD capability revalidation.
escalations.resolution: Invoker authorized one guided correction round scoped to exactly these 4 findings and reset the rework counter.
escalations.recommendation: Guided correction: worktree-keyed serialization / data-root-bound companion markers; idempotent committed-recovery cleanup; model kernel-only failure points in memory backend; reopen-by-path revalidation.

escalations.situation: code-review run b1991dfd-f094-43b5-961b-b310bac4d4f6 failed with one high finding: production mutation paths (IssueStore per-file publishers, init/profile direct FileTransactionKernel use) are not migrated to open_mutation_session, reading the issue's 'no per-file or command-semantic method survives' as requiring adoption in this package. The approved breakdown defers consumer migration to 49adf23b (wave 5) and the cutover to 661d6be2 (wave 6).
escalations.resolution: Invoker approved amending bacf2cd4's description to codify the adoption boundary (predecessor paths remain as tracked deletion debt until 49adf23b/661d6be2); code-review re-run against the amended contract.
escalations.recommendation: Amend issue text to codify the approved plan rather than pulling wave-5 scope into wave 2.

escalations.situation: code-review round 3 failed on a new high finding: validate_repository_journal checks duplicate journal paths but never rechecks pairwise physical-identity aliases, though the spec requires recovery to recheck physical uniqueness. Sibling of round 2's delta-normalization alias gap; rework counter at MAX (2).
escalations.resolution: Invoker authorized one guided round with counter reset: fix the recovery-side recheck AND sweep every normative spec clause against the implementation, fixing all real gaps in one minimal pass; explicit caution against over-engineering, be systematic and rigorous.
escalations.recommendation: Close the class (all spec-named alias/uniqueness boundaries), not just the cited instance.

escalations.situation: code-review round 5 failed on a second backend-parity instance (absent-root Data-only delta without explicit root entry: JSON publishes the staged root, memory never materializes the Data("") entry). Five rounds, five distinct findings; the last two share the delta-shape parity class that the worker's enumeration sweep failed to close.
escalations.resolution: Invoker chose a batch conformance audit (wave-1 remedy): disjoint-footprint auditors over the wave-2 surface vs the issue contract with adversarial verification, then one fix pass for all confirmed findings before re-gating.
escalations.recommendation: Lead recommended fix + property-based parity test; invoker selected the broader audit.

escalations.situation: After two rework attempts closed the original seed-omission finding, plan encapsulation, and HashMap serialization nondeterminism, final adversarial review found one ordinary API pairing defect: RepositoryMutationSession::apply accepts image and plan separately, so a plan derived from image A can be applied alongside image B when action-target preimages match, recording A's semantic hash after revalidating B.
escalations.resolution: Invoker authorized option 1: one minimal guided correction that makes MaterializationPlan own its captured RepositoryImage and makes apply accept only the plan, followed by the issue gates.
escalations.recommendation: Authorize one guided minimal correction: MaterializationPlan owns the captured RepositoryImage and apply accepts only the plan, structurally binding image, delta, and hash without storage-side rehashing or a validation framework.

escalations.situation: The invoker-authorized owned-image correction and a subsequent canonical lease-identity correction passed independent review and cargo-ci, but code-review run cbee4805-53b0-400d-891d-7ded5ffcec3e found one new medium scope violation: the collision-test helper added fresh Issue::new and save_issue callers even though the approved scope amendment freezes those predecessor APIs until wave 5. The wave-3 rework counter has reached 2.
escalations.resolution: Invoker authorized one narrow test-fixture-only guided correction and reset the rework counter.
escalations.recommendation: Authorize one narrow test-fixture-only correction: remove the new predecessor caller by extending or reusing the existing claim-test fixture boundary (or by using the typed finalizer), preserve the collision regressions, then rerun focused tests, independent review, and both issue gates.

escalations.situation: 44d318ab's issue text described live jit validate/--fix and project-render behavior, but plan §3/D16 assigns that consumer wiring to 49adf23b and acceptance evidence to b1621508; the worker also produced concrete blocker evidence (InMemoryStorage two-store split, missing validation-closure capture planner).
escalations.resolution: Invoker approved amending 44d318ab to the plan boundary (commit d2685611): this package owns the complete REQ-06 mechanism with unit/harness tests; the live-command sentences state the end state 49adf23b completes.
